title: Disposable Full Cycle acceptance: reject, rework, add_tasks
goal: Exercise the review loop on a fresh offline Python text-statistics library: one rejection with rework, a regression check, and a task added at project review. The plan is intentionally incomplete: the project check runs tests/test_report.py, which no initial task may create; the tech lead adds the task `report` with add_tasks at the project review. Exactly one project agent; no network, no deployment, no external resources.
acceptance_criteria: Task word-count is rejected once on purpose at review, reworked as attempt 2 from the reviewer's feedback, then approved
Every later task keeps all earlier tests passing (regression)
Task report is added by an add_tasks decision at the project review and then approved
All unittest checks pass; only scoped files change
No secrets, money, network or production interaction
do_not_touch: Any files outside the disposable project

tasks.title: Word counting
tasks.goal: Create textstats.py with a pure function word_count(text: str) -> int that counts words separated by spaces, and tests/__init__.py (empty) plus tests/test_word_count.py using standard library unittest.
acceptance_criteria: Single and multiple space-separated words are counted

tasks.title: Character statistics
tasks.goal: Add char_count(text, include_spaces=True) -> int and longest_word(text) -> str to textstats.py (longest_word returns '' for no words; on ties the first one). Add tests/test_char_stats.py. Do not change or remove existing tests.
acceptance_criteria: Both functions tested including empty input and ties
All earlier tests retained and passing
